evidence: Requirement -> criterion map built from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md against all 2 gate + 36 functional + 5 polish + 5 visual criteria. WELL COVERED (strengths): sign-in (hro_gate_render), 401 anonymous (hro_anonymous), job opening + 1..50 places + HM-account rule (hro_job_open), add candidate bottom of Applied (hro_add_candidate), email validity/case-insensitive duplicate/field-level error/typed text kept/other-job allowed (hro_add_email_rules), account linking (hro_candidate_linked), one-stage moves, skip refused, non-drag controls (hro_move_one_stage), arrive at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), shared manual order (hro_reorder), reject reason/rejected-from/Hired refusal/reopen-only-to-origin/reason cleared (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired, hro_reopen), Interview places incl. reorder-when-full and freed place (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free), refused-move put-back + reason + focus (hro_refused_put_back), HM late stages / early refused / other job (hro_mgr_*), observer + candidate read-only (hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff), stale 409-type conflict naming who (hro_stale_refused), bulk move board order / all-or-none / places counted for set (hro_bulk_*), undo restore/conflict/once/over-capacity/reason restore (hro_undo_*, hro_reopen), activity incl. reason, newest first, job filter, refusals add nothing (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), notes permissions (hro_notes), unsaved note survives reload (hro_pol_failed_send), live board within 15 s (hro_live_board), preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll (hro_pol_live_board), live thread draft/focus (hro_pol_live_thread), message exchange/compose/Enter/Shift+Enter/focus/failed send (hro_msg_exchange, hro_msg_compose, hro_pol_failed_send), 30-message pages and anchored load (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), unread per person + total + own never unread (hro_unread_counts), scrolled-up arrival (hro_unread_scrolled_up), seen incl. observer-never-counts (hro_seen), thread access per role (hro_thread_access), drafts per conversation/reload/sign-out/other user (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate wording/ownership/privacy/404 (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private), restart persistence + no reseed (hro_restart), desktop Board/Conversations/Activity/candidate views (visual likerts). Runtime contract items (Express/SQLite/PORT/health/DB_PATH/no installs) are shared harness/runtime policy, correctly not browser criteria. Representative sampling inside a stated rule (e.g. HM reject only from Interview, undo conflict only via a move, seen via recruiter not HM) is accepted as flow coverage per the SKILL false-positive and workbook internal note. GAPS (stated rules with no criterion or protocol step that observes them): (1) hireops_rules.md:99 'Adding a note does not count as a change.' (for undo). No protocol adds a note to a card between its move and the undo; N (notes) runs after B's undo steps on different cards, and no criterion mentions it. An app that bumps the card version on note save and then refuses undo is never caught. (2) hireops_rules.md:156-158 'When a message arrives in the conversation someone has open: if they are at the newest message, it is shown and counts as read.' hro_pol_live_thread grades only draft/focus/view position; hro_msg_exchange grades only arrival; hro_unread_counts reads counts with the conversation NOT open ('Tomas's new conversation not open'); hro_unread_scrolled_up covers only the scrolled-up branch. The 'counts as read' leg of the at-newest branch is ungraded. (3) hireops_rules.md:105-106 an unsaved note draft 'is kept for that person on that browser' - the per-person isolation of note drafts is ungraded (hro_pol_session_resume checks Mei sees no reply draft, but nothing checks note drafts after a user switch). Lower-weight observations (Note, not counted toward Fail): (4) instruction.md:3 'when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who' and rules:78-80 'their board shows the card where it really is' - hro_stale_refused accepts the name 'in the response or on screen' via a replay, so the on-screen conflict message and conflict-path put-back are not observed; a feasible deterministic UI-staleness probe is hard with SSE/polling apps (REVIEW_POLICY tool-feasibility), and hro_refused_put_back covers the general put-back mechanism, so this is a justified compromise but should be recorded. (5) rules:21-23 status codes 403 (role) and 409 (stale) are not asserted; only 401 and the candidate 404 are. Criteria grade 'refused, nothing changes', which is the product outcome; status-code shape is arguably API detail. (6) Candidate 'source' field (rules:31) is entered but never read back. (7) rules:84 'A move appears on the mover's board immediately' (optimistic display) is not required by hro_refused_put_back, which also passes a UI that refuses before moving; consistent with brief line 3 only loosely. Gaps 1-3 are explicit public rules that a plausible broken app could violate while earning full credit, so per the workbook text ('no asked-for behavior goes ungraded. Reports every gap') this row fails; each is narrow, so P2.
counterexample: Broken app passing every criterion: (a) saving an internal note increments the card version, so 'Rafael moves Z, adds a note to Z, presses Undo' is refused as 'card changed since' - contradicts rules:99, no criterion observes it; (b) with Rafael viewing Tomas's conversation at its newest message, Tomas's new message is appended and shown but the unread badge for that conversation and the total increase by 1 and stay until Rafael navigates away and reopens it - contradicts rules:157, hro_pol_live_thread/hro_msg_exchange/hro_unread_counts all still pass; (c) note drafts stored in localStorage keyed only by card id, so after Rafael signs out, Mei opens the same card on that browser and sees Rafael's unsaved note - contradicts rules:105-106, hro_pol_failed_send (reload only) still passes.
suggested_fix: Add legs to existing criteria/protocols: in B(12) have Rafael add a note to A2 before its undo and require the undo to succeed (hro_undo_restores or hro_undo_conflict); in U have Rafael's page open on Tomas's conversation at its newest when Tomas sends and require his count/total not to rise (hro_unread_counts or hro_msg_exchange); in polish hro_pol_session_resume (or hro_notes) add that Mei on the same browser does not see Rafael's unsaved note draft. Optionally record the stale-conflict on-screen leg as a deliberate feasibility compromise.
